_doc: Palette atlas (docs/VISUALS.md §3, §6.1). Rows = material family, 16 swatch columns. Models store the swatch in UV; the scale-model shader samples this texture. Column meanings for rows 0-3: camo, camo dark, camo third, gunmetal, rubber, canvas, skin, uniform, webbing, helmet, glass, concrete, wood, rust, earth/sandbag, marking. Row 4 (nature): pine needles, spruce, birch gold, birch bark, bark, moss, reed, aspen, granite, lichen, roof, plaster, planks, rust, concrete, window.
